headline: Executive order signed in 2017 calls for identifying federal tax regulations seen as burdensome and reducing them.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs the federal government to find tax regulations that create burdens and to take steps to reduce them. No summary was provided, so details such as which agencies are involved, which rules are covered, and any deadlines cannot be confirmed here.

who_it_affects.how: They would likely be the ones asked to review tax rules and look for ways to reduce burdens.
Any tax rules that are later changed or removed as a result could affect the paperwork or requirements they face.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 21, 2017; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
